parts.name: Form
parts.description: Radix form root using native constraint validation. Use FormField, FormLabel and FormControl for native controls, not a nested TextField or non-native Select.

props.name: onClearServerErrors
props.description: Clear previous server errors before the submit callback and after an uncancelled reset. Editing alone does not invoke it.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called after native validation permits form submission. Prevent default for client-side handling.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Native reset handler. Prevent default to cancel reset and server-error clearing.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form submission field name.

props.name: target
props.description: Browsing context for the linked destination, such as _self or _blank.

props.name: action
props.description: Native form submission destination or React form action.

props.name: method
props.description: Native form submission method.

props.name: noValidate
props.description: Skip built-in constraint validation during form submission.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through one child element instead of the default element. The child must forward its ref and accept the supplied props.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: FormControl
parts.description: Native input validation integration. Use asChild with a single Input or TextareaInput; this does not add native validation to Select.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Compose with one native-input-compatible child, such as Input or TextareaInput. Select is not a native validation control.

props.name: type
props.description: Native control type.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form submission field name.

props.name: value
props.description: Current native control value. Pair with onChange for controlled input.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value used when the native control is uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native input change handler. Read value or checked from event.currentTarget.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires a non-empty native control value during form validation.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Keeps the current value readable and focusable while preventing editing.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when the control has no value.

props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

parts.name: FormMessage
parts.description: Conditional validation feedback for a named field. Renders when match succeeds or forceMatch is true.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: name
props.description: Target field name; inherited from the surrounding FormField when omitted.

props.name: match
props.type: "badInput" | "patternMismatch" | "rangeOverflow" | "rangeUnderflow" | "stepMismatch" | "tooLong" | "tooShort" | "typeMismatch" | "valid" | "valueMissing" | (((value: string, formData: FormData) => boolean) | ((value: string, formData: FormData) => Promise<boolean>))
props.description: Native ValidityState key or custom matcher deciding when the message appears.

props.name: forceMatch
props.description: Show the message independently of the current validation result.

props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.
